title: 11 · Quillon: purchase request approval
strengths: The consequence comes before the decision: 'If you approve' shows the Q4 Facilities budget bar (60% spent, +15% this request in ink, $23,340 left of $96,000, arithmetic exact) and the next step: 'Rhea Kapoor (CFO) approves next. Then PO-10482 goes to Ashbury, paid on Net 30.'

The policy line and the approval chain are plain and complete: 'Policy FIN-04: over $10,000 also needs the CFO', then four steps by shape and word (two filled checks, 'You' as a ring 'waiting since 09:40', the CFO hollow 'next')

Native iOS chrome rebuilt from shipped apps: status bar, '‹ Approvals' with a '1 of 4' title and previous and next arrows, inset-grouped cards, a decision bar with 'Decline' and 'Approve $14,860' at 50 pt, a labelled tab bar with a badge, Dynamic Type sizes 34/22/17/15/13/11
slop_signals: Uppercase grey section headers ('IF YOU APPROVE', 'APPROVALS · 2 OF 4 STEPS DONE') look older than current iOS work apps
Large grey 'Decline' pill beside an equally large green primary; the tab badge is a red '4' on a green filled icon, two status colors in the tab bar
fixes: Rename the app 'Quillon' (Fennick lists a vendor 'Quillon Software') and 'Owen Castillo' (heroes/10 has R. Castillo)
Use sentence-case section headers and a quieter Decline (text or outline) so the one decision reads first

references.what: Approval status as a vertical timeline with pending reviewers; ours adds roles, times and why the CFO is next
Decline and Approve pinned at the bottom with balance impact; ours shows the budget impact as a bar
Approval card stating the consequence and deadline; ours is more exact about money

facts: mockups/10-multi-device (not edited): desktop.html links this piece's tokens.css, so it turns cobalt on its next render; ten copy and colour changes for it are listed in app-screens/11-approvals-mobile/notes.md under Round 3, and desktop.png and the mockup's shot.png need a re-render
fixed: Budget period 'Q4' (60% spent two weeks into the quarter) is now 'Jul–Dec' (3.5 of 6 months gone, 60% spent); amounts unchanged
Owen Castillo → Owen Marchetti; the app keeps the name Quillon and Fennick's vendor was renamed instead

changed: Tab bar hidden on this pushed screen; the decision bar is the only bottom bar (12 pt above 50 pt buttons, 34 pt home area), translucent, with a Details card scrolling under it
8 pt rhythm: 24 between sections, 8 header to card, 16 inside cards, 58 pt sign-off rows; all four steps above the bar
Type at iOS roles: names, labels and vendor at 17, details at 15, sentence-case headers at 13 regular
Own identity next to Fennick: cobalt accent through the engine, request ID 'PR-2207' as the title, whole dollars, its own section labels
Sign-off counted right (1 of 3 approved; the requester is an arrow), times in their own column, plain phrases, policy on the CFO's row
Budget legend no longer adds to 99%; graphic contrast raised (ring #868686, track #d2d2d2, spent #757575); Decline outlined, regular weight
Fresh-eyes audit: 3/5 then 4/5; its last four items applied
